versions.changelog:
Initial release of kitchen-war-rts: a complete, single-file HTML5 Red Alert-style RTS playable in any browser.

- Features base building, resource harvesting, unit production, tech tree, fog of war, group selection/commands, enemy AI, superweapon, and win/loss conditions.
- Includes a help overlay, achievements, sound/music toggles, screenshot/share, persistent toolbar options, and hotkeys for accessibility.
- All gameplay and interface features detailed in the SKILL.md are implemented and verified with a full real-browser end-to-end test suite to ensure reliable play and no runtime errors.
- Delivered as a self-contained index.html with no external dependencies.
